subject: Entrepreneurship Development
notes: Entrepreneurship core. No numerical questions apply; extra objective and case items included.

questions.text: A person who starts a business and bears the risk for profit is an
questions.subject: Entrepreneurship Development
questions.explanation: An entrepreneur organises resources and bears risk for profit.

questions.text: The process of setting up a business enterprise is called
questions.subject: Entrepreneurship Development
questions.explanation: Entrepreneurship is the process of creating a new business venture.

questions.text: An entrepreneur who starts a business within an existing organisation is an
questions.subject: Entrepreneurship Development
questions.explanation: An intrapreneur innovates inside an established company.

questions.text: Entrepreneurs are born and cannot be developed through training
questions.subject: Entrepreneurship Development
questions.explanation: Entrepreneurial skills and attitudes can be developed through education and training.

questions.text: List the characteristics of a successful entrepreneur
questions.subject: Entrepreneurship Development
questions.correctAnswer: Initiative risk bearing innovation self confidence and perseverance.
questions.explanation: These traits enable entrepreneurs to succeed.

questions.text: Explain the functions of an entrepreneur
questions.subject: Entrepreneurship Development
questions.correctAnswer: The entrepreneur identifies opportunities innovates organises resources bears risk and makes decisions to build and grow the venture.
questions.explanation: Cover innovation risk bearing and resource mobilisation.

questions.text: An entrepreneur who merely imitates existing businesses is a
questions.subject: Entrepreneurship Development
questions.explanation: Imitative entrepreneurs copy successful ventures rather than innovate.

questions.text: Entrepreneurs who are cautious and adopt innovations slowly are called
questions.subject: Entrepreneurship Development
questions.explanation: Fabian entrepreneurs imitate only when not adopting would threaten them.

questions.text: A woman entrepreneur is one who owns and runs an enterprise with at least half ownership
questions.subject: Entrepreneurship Development
questions.explanation: A woman entrepreneur owns and manages an enterprise with majority stake.

questions.text: Distinguish between an entrepreneur and a manager
questions.subject: Entrepreneurship Development
questions.correctAnswer: An entrepreneur is an owner who bears risk and innovates while a manager is an employee who executes plans for a salary.
questions.explanation: The difference is in ownership risk bearing and innovation.

questions.text: Explain the role of entrepreneurship in economic development
questions.subject: Entrepreneurship Development
questions.correctAnswer: Entrepreneurship creates jobs promotes innovation mobilises resources reduces regional imbalances and raises national income and exports.
questions.explanation: Cover employment innovation and balanced development.

questions.text: The process of scanning the environment to discover business possibilities is
questions.subject: Entrepreneurship Development
questions.explanation: Opportunity identification finds viable business ideas in the environment.

questions.text: The study that assesses whether a business idea is technically financially and economically viable is a
questions.subject: Entrepreneurship Development
questions.explanation: A feasibility study tests the viability of a proposed venture.

questions.text: A business opportunity exists only when there is customer demand and profit potential
questions.subject: Entrepreneurship Development
questions.explanation: A real opportunity combines demand with the ability to serve it profitably.

questions.text: List the steps in identifying a business opportunity
questions.subject: Entrepreneurship Development
questions.correctAnswer: Idea generation scanning the environment screening ideas and evaluating feasibility.
questions.explanation: These steps convert raw ideas into viable opportunities.

questions.text: Explain the components of a feasibility study
questions.subject: Entrepreneurship Development
questions.correctAnswer: A feasibility study covers market technical financial and economic aspects assessing demand production methods costs profitability and social impact.
questions.explanation: Cover each dimension of feasibility assessment.

questions.text: The written document that describes the business idea and its execution plan is a
questions.subject: Entrepreneurship Development
questions.explanation: A business plan is the roadmap for starting and running the venture.

questions.text: The section of a business plan that summarises the whole plan is the
questions.subject: Entrepreneurship Development
questions.explanation: The executive summary gives a concise overview of the entire plan.

questions.text: A business plan is useful only for large companies not for startups
questions.subject: Entrepreneurship Development
questions.explanation: Startups especially need business plans to guide them and attract finance.

questions.text: List the main components of a business plan
questions.subject: Entrepreneurship Development
questions.correctAnswer: Executive summary description of business market plan operations plan and financial plan.
questions.explanation: These sections together describe and justify the venture.

questions.text: Explain the importance of a business plan
questions.subject: Entrepreneurship Development
questions.correctAnswer: A business plan guides the entrepreneur attracts investors and lenders clarifies objectives and helps monitor progress against targets.
questions.explanation: Cover guidance finance raising and control benefits.

questions.text: The organisation that provides financial and non financial support to small industries in India is
questions.subject: Entrepreneurship Development
questions.explanation: MSME Development Institutes support micro small and medium enterprises.

questions.text: The apex institution that provides long term finance to small industries is
questions.subject: Entrepreneurship Development
questions.explanation: The Small Industries Development Bank of India finances small industries.

questions.text: The Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana provides loans to small and micro enterprises
questions.subject: Entrepreneurship Development
questions.explanation: Mudra Yojana offers loans to micro enterprises without collateral.

questions.text: List the institutions supporting entrepreneurs in India
questions.subject: Entrepreneurship Development
questions.correctAnswer: SIDBI DIC NSIC SIDO and state financial corporations.
questions.explanation: These institutions provide finance training and marketing support.

questions.text: Explain the role of SIDBI in promoting small industries
questions.subject: Entrepreneurship Development
questions.correctAnswer: SIDBI provides refinance direct finance and promotional support to small industries and coordinates the flow of credit to the MSME sector.
questions.explanation: Cover refinancing direct lending and developmental support.

questions.text: A newly established business with high growth potential based on innovation is a
questions.subject: Entrepreneurship Development
questions.explanation: A startup is a new innovative venture designed for rapid growth.

questions.text: MSME stands for Micro Small and Medium
questions.subject: Entrepreneurship Development
questions.explanation: MSMEs are classified by investment in plant and machinery and turnover.

questions.text: Women entrepreneurs face unique challenges including limited access to finance
questions.subject: Entrepreneurship Development
questions.explanation: Access to finance mobility and social attitudes challenge women entrepreneurs.

questions.text: State the problems faced by women entrepreneurs
questions.subject: Entrepreneurship Development
questions.correctAnswer: Lack of finance limited mobility family responsibilities and social attitudes.
questions.explanation: These constraints hinder the growth of women owned businesses.

questions.text: Explain the importance of MSMEs in the Indian economy
questions.subject: Entrepreneurship Development
questions.correctAnswer: MSMEs generate employment promote regional balance use local resources and contribute significantly to exports and industrial output.
questions.explanation: Cover employment output exports and balanced regional growth.

questions.text: Assertion: Entrepreneurship creates employment opportunities. Reason: New ventures hire people to produce and sell goods and services
questions.subject: Entrepreneurship Development
options: Both assertion and reason are true and reason explains assertion
Both are true but reason does not explain assertion
Assertion is true but reason is false
Assertion is false but reason is true
questions.explanation: New ventures generate jobs directly and indirectly through their operations.

questions.text: Match the type of entrepreneur to the description
questions.subject: Entrepreneurship Development
questions.explanation: Innovative entrepreneurs introduce new ideas while imitative ones copy.

questions.text: The analysis of strengths weaknesses opportunities and threats before starting a venture is
questions.subject: Entrepreneurship Development
questions.explanation: SWOT analysis evaluates internal and external factors affecting the venture.

questions.text: The stage of entrepreneurial development that motivates people to become entrepreneurs is
questions.subject: Entrepreneurship Development
questions.explanation: Entrepreneurship development programmes begin by motivating potential entrepreneurs.

questions.text: Explain the stages of entrepreneurial development programmes
questions.subject: Entrepreneurship Development
questions.correctAnswer: EDPs proceed through pre training to identify and motivate participants training to develop skills and post training follow up support for project implementation.
questions.explanation: Cover the pre training training and post training phases.

questions.text: A business owned and run entirely by one person who bears all risk is a sole proprietorship
questions.subject: Entrepreneurship Development
questions.explanation: A sole proprietorship is owned by one person with unlimited liability.

questions.text: Explain the sources of finance for a new venture
questions.subject: Entrepreneurship Development
questions.correctAnswer: Own funds family and friends bank loans venture capital angel investors and government schemes.
questions.explanation: These sources provide capital at different stages of the venture.

questions.text: Read the case: An aspiring entrepreneur has an idea for an organic food outlet but limited funds and no market data. Suggest the first three steps she should take
questions.subject: Entrepreneurship Development
questions.correctAnswer: She should first conduct market research to test demand then prepare a feasibility study and finally develop a business plan to guide execution and raise finance.
questions.explanation: Sequence market research feasibility and business planning.

questions.text: Read the case: A small manufacturing unit has good orders but cannot get a bank loan due to lack of collateral. Suggest a government scheme and an institution that can help
questions.subject: Entrepreneurship Development
questions.correctAnswer: The unit can use the Mudra Yojana for collateral free loans and approach SIDBI or a state financial corporation for refinance and guarantee support.
questions.explanation: Match the collateral problem to suitable schemes and institutions.

questions.text: The liability of an entrepreneur in a sole proprietorship is
questions.subject: Entrepreneurship Development
questions.explanation: A sole proprietor has unlimited liability for business debts.

questions.text: Explain the role of entrepreneurship in employment generation
questions.subject: Entrepreneurship Development
questions.correctAnswer: Entrepreneurs create direct jobs in their ventures and indirect jobs in suppliers and service providers reducing unemployment and raising incomes.
questions.explanation: Cover direct and indirect employment effects.

questions.text: The full form of DIC is District Industries
questions.subject: Entrepreneurship Development
questions.explanation: District Industries Centres promote small industries at the district level.

questions.text: Explain the problems faced by entrepreneurs in India
questions.subject: Entrepreneurship Development
questions.correctAnswer: Entrepreneurs face problems of finance infrastructure raw materials marketing competition and bureaucratic procedures in India.
questions.explanation: Cover financial infrastructural and market related constraints.

questions.text: The entrepreneurship development programmes in India were pioneered by the Entrepreneurship Development Institute of India
questions.subject: Entrepreneurship Development
questions.explanation: The Entrepreneurship Development Institute of India pioneered EDPs in India.

questions.text: Explain the concept and importance of innovation in entrepreneurship
questions.subject: Entrepreneurship Development
questions.correctAnswer: Innovation is introducing new products processes or methods and it gives the entrepreneur competitive advantage and growth. Schumpeter saw innovation as the core of entrepreneurship.
questions.explanation: Link innovation to competitive advantage and Schumpeters view.

questions.text: List the types of entrepreneurs on the basis of scale
questions.subject: Entrepreneurship Development
questions.correctAnswer: Small scale and large scale entrepreneurs based on the size of investment and operations.
questions.explanation: Scale of operations distinguishes these categories.

questions.text: The scheme that supports startups with funding mentorship and incubation in India is
questions.subject: Entrepreneurship Development
questions.explanation: Startup India provides funding incubation and regulatory support to startups.

questions.text: Explain the role of women entrepreneurs in economic development
questions.subject: Entrepreneurship Development
questions.correctAnswer: Women entrepreneurs create employment empower women raise household income and bring diversity to business contributing to inclusive economic growth.
questions.explanation: Cover employment empowerment and inclusive growth benefits.

questions.text: Distinguish between entrepreneurship and intrapreneurship
questions.subject: Entrepreneurship Development
questions.correctAnswer: Entrepreneurship creates a new independent venture while intrapreneurship innovates within an existing organisation using its resources.
questions.explanation: The setting and ownership of the risk distinguish the two.
